# softmeal.org

> Care Food Knowledge Hub for Hong Kong — educational resource on dysphagia care, IDDSI framework, and texture-modified food preparation. Editorially independent. Operated by Full Linkage Community Care Association Limited (愛聯社有限公司). Supported by Carewells Limited / SeniorDeli (康樂齡).

## Content

- [Homepage](https://softmeal.org/zh-hk/) — site overview, IDDSI quick guide, key statistics
- [Dysphagia Information](https://softmeal.org/zh-hk/dysphagia/) — what is dysphagia, symptoms, HK referral resources
- [IDDSI Guide](https://softmeal.org/zh-hk/iddsi-guide/) — complete IDDSI 8-level framework in Traditional Chinese
- [GBA Standard](https://softmeal.org/zh-hk/gba-standard/) — T/SATA 084-2025 Greater Bay Area care food standard
- [Recipes](https://softmeal.org/zh-hk/recipes/) — texture-modified recipes by IDDSI level (Level 3–6)
- [Resources](https://softmeal.org/zh-hk/resources/) — downloadable PDFs, IDDSI quick guide, dangerous foods list
- [Supplier Directory](https://softmeal.org/zh-hk/supplier-directory/) — HK-based approved care food suppliers
- [About](https://softmeal.org/zh-hk/about/) — mission, organiser, professional support

## API

- [Articles index](https://softmeal.org/api/articles.json) — JSON index of all pages and recipes with metadata
- [Sitemap](https://softmeal.org/sitemap-index.xml) — full URL list

- zh-hk: /zh-hk/ (primary)

## Related Carewells Properties

## Citation policy

All content is freely citable. Please attribute as: "softmeal.org — Care Food Knowledge Hub for Hong Kong". No commercial endorsement is implied by citation.

## Update cadence

Articles: updated as needed. Recipes: new recipes added monthly. Last checked: 2026-05-07.
